The sound is caused because the circulator is hitting the inside of the metal sleeve.

I *believe* that this is because the metal sleeve and the plastic housing are not a particularly tight fit, and this allows some "wobble" in the sleeve.

This is compounded by the way the the clamp is cantilevered off of the side of whatever tub/container you use, and unless the container is *totally* rigid then it tends to bend inwards towards the container, and where the sleeve isn't totally snug that tends to try and hang more vertical.

To fix this issue, all I have done, is glue a cork to the back wall of the tub about halfway down where the metal sleeve is, so when the cantilevered weight of the circulator tries to bend in towards the back, the cork gives it support and helps it all stay vertical.
